Class ViewListLessons

java.lang.Object
guiListLessons.ViewListLessons
public class ViewListLessons extends Object

Title: ViewListLessons Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based page for listing lessons. This class provides the JavaFX GUI widgets that enable an admin to display all the current lessons and their information.

The class has been written using a singleton design pattern and is the View portion of the Model, View, Controller pattern. The pattern is designed that the all accesses to this page and its functions starts by invoking the static method displayListUsers. No other method should attempt to instantiate this class as that is controlled by displayListUsers. It ensure that only one instance of class is instantiated and that one is properly configured for each use.

Please note that this implementation is not appropriate for concurrent systems with multiple users. This Baeldung article provides insight into the issues: https://www.baeldung.com/java-singleton

  • Constructor Details

    • ViewListLessons

      public ViewListLessons()

      Method: ViewListLessonsPage()

      Description: This method initializes all the elements of the graphical user interface. This method determines the location, size, font, color, and event handlers for each GUI object. It also determines the getter function for each column in the table.

      This is a singleton, so this is performed just one. Subsequent uses fill in the changeable fields using the displayListLessons method.

  • Method Details

    • displayListLessons

      public static void displayListLessons(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)

      Method: displayListLessons(Stage ps, User user)

      Description: This method is the single entry point from outside this package to cause the list lessons page to be displayed. It first sets up very shared attributes so we don't have to pass parameters. Next it updates the list of user information. It then checks to see if the page has been setup. If not, it instantiates the class, initializes all the static aspects of the GUI widgets (e.g., location on the page, font, size, and any methods to be performed). After the instantiation, the code sets the Scene onto the stage, and makes it visible to the user.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the current User
